limits: A 2% timing resolution is not a per-stage slowdown budget; compare both references.
Bootstrap intervals are approximate; inconclusive results require an isolated recheck.
Passing measured budgets does not establish language completeness or universal C parity.

diagnostic_before_integration.scope: Diagnostic backend-quality probe, not an acceptance gate. Scalar native and C compile the same exported IR; accepted retains its existing vectorization. GCC O2 may inline within each split C unit. The supported compiler and language are unchanged.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

limits: Compiler-host optimization is a minutes-long release build, not the normal edit/test loop or a C backend for applications.
The optional host requires Linux x86-64 and its C library; generated applications retain their existing native/web targets.
The host retains GCC function debug information but not Dewy custom source-line stack tables.
Runtime artifact certificates establish unchanged generated programs, not new measurements of C parity.
The 250k fresh root lines/s target remains unmet; absolute rates depend on this busy variable-frequency host.
Native Dunes paired median is about 0.8% slower, within the existing 2% gate resolution; the cumulative fixed-reference check passes. The resolution is not a per-stage slowdown budget.
